name: Overnight Delivery Workflow
description: Complete autonomous development workflow: plan → implement → test → review → deliver with max 3 fix-test cycles

agents.wf-planner: Inspects repo, writes implementation plan, no code changes
agents.wf-coder: Implements approved changes, adds tests, maintains functionality
agents.wf-code-reviewer: Reviews code quality, architecture, security independently
agents.wf-qa: Runs builds, tests, regression tests, device testing

steps.name: Task Intake & Scope Definition
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Planner. Your task is to:

1. Read and understand the task description carefully
2. Inspect the arcade-games repository structure
3. Review existing games (2-3 examples) to understand patterns
4. Identify all acceptance criteria
5. List any dependencies or blockers
6. Create a detailed implementation plan with:
   - Architecture overview
   - Step-by-step implementation checklist
   - Code patterns and examples
   - Testing strategy
   - Risk assessment
   - Feasibility determination (go/no-go)

Deliverables:
- arcade-plan-[feature].md with complete implementation plan
- Go/no-go recommendation
- Any identified risks or blockers

Reference: .kiro/agents/arcade-planner.md for detailed responsibilities

steps.name: Lead Reviews Scope & Plan
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Lead. Review the planner's work:

1. Read the implementation plan thoroughly
2. Verify scope is clear and matches task requirements
3. Identify any blockers or risks
4. Check feasibility determination
5. Approve plan OR request revisions
6. Create scope summary document

Deliverables:
- Scope summary approval (go/no-go)
- Any identified scope issues
- Lead sign-off for development to begin

Reference: .kiro/agents/arcade-lead.md for scope definition responsibilities

steps.name: Development: Implement Feature
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Developer. Implement the feature per the approved plan:

1. Create feature branch: git checkout -b feature/[feature-name]
2. Follow implementation plan step-by-step
3. Implement code in www/index.html
4. Test incrementally after each major section
5. Verify all 15 existing games still work (regression)
6. Make atomic commits (2-5 commits, clear messages)
7. Push to feature branch

Deliverables:
- Commits on feature branch
- All acceptance criteria implemented
- Regression testing completed and documented

Reference: .kiro/agents/arcade-developer.md for implementation responsibilities

branches.name: QA: Build & Test
branches.prompt:
You are the Arcade QA. Test the implementation:

1. Verify build succeeds:
   - npm install completes
   - npx cap sync android succeeds
   - APK builds without errors
   - APK file size reasonable (5-7 MB)

2. Run all automated tests (if framework exists)

3. Manual regression testing:
   - Test all 15 games for 30+ seconds each
   - Document each game: PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED

4. Device testing:
   - Install APK on Android device (6.0+)
   - App launches without errors
   - Feature works as expected
   - No crashes detected
   - Audio/themes work correctly

5. Report any defects with:
   - Reproduction steps
   - Severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)
   - Impact assessment

Deliverables:
- Build verification report
- Regression test results (all 15 games)
- Device test report
- Defect list (if any)

Reference: .kiro/agents/arcade-qa.md for testing responsibilities

branches.name: Review: Code Quality & Architecture
branches.prompt:
You are the Arcade Reviewer. Review the code changes:

1. Code quality audit:
   - No hardcoded values
   - All user input sanitized (esc())
   - State changes use spread syntax (not mutation)
   - No console.log() in production
   - No unused variables
   - Comments explain complex logic
   - Code follows conventions

2. Architecture audit:
   - Game lifecycle correct (Start → Playing → End)
   - Local gameState only (not in global S)
   - High scores correctly updated (S.gb[gameId])
   - Audio integration theme-aware
   - Navigation works correctly
   - State persists via save()

3. Security & privacy audit:
   - No personal data collection
   - No third-party tracking
   - No external web navigation
   - No prohibited permissions
   - Input validation prevents injection

4. Regression impact:
   - No changes to existing games (unless intended)
   - No state corruption
   - No theme issues
   - Navigation still works

5. Maintainability:
   - Code is understandable
   - Functions reasonably sized
   - Reuses existing patterns
   - No premature optimization

Deliverables:
- Code review report
- Approval OR request changes
- List of any issues found

Reference: .kiro/agents/arcade-reviewer.md for review responsibilities

steps.name: Lead: Integration Assessment
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Lead. Assess integration and quality gate status:

1. Review QA test results
   - Build status: PASS / FAIL
   - Regression results: all 15 games working?
   - Device testing: successful?
   - Defects: any CRITICAL or HIGH issues?

2. Review code review
   - Code approved?
   - Architecture sound?
   - Security/privacy OK?
   - Any blocking issues?

3. Compare against acceptance gates (06-acceptance-gates.md):
   - Gate 1: Feature Completeness
   - Gate 2: Regression Testing
   - Gate 3: Tests
   - Gate 4: Linting & Build
   - Gate 5: Android Build
   - Gate 6: Device Testing
   - Gate 7: Defect Review
   - Gate 8: Privacy Compliance
   - Gate 9: Documentation
   - Gate 10: Git Status

4. Make integration decision:
   - ALL gates PASS → Approve for merge
   - ANY gate FAIL → Request fixes (go to fix cycle)
   - ANY gate BLOCKED → Escalate blockers

Deliverables:
- Integration assessment report
- Gate-by-gate status summary
- Go/no-go recommendation

Reference: .kiro/agents/arcade-lead.md for integration responsibilities

steps.name: Fix Cycle: Address Failures (Max 3 Cycles)
Lead: Identify Fixes Needed
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Lead. Based on test and review failures:

1. Identify which gates failed
2. For each failure, determine:
   - What specifically failed
   - Who should fix it (developer, or configuration/build issue)
   - Is it fixable, or is work blocked?
3. Document fixes needed in priority order
4. If fixes are complex or scope changes, escalate
5. If all issues are unfixable, recommend stopping

Deliverables:
- List of fixes needed
- Priority and assignment
- Blockers or escalations if any

steps.name: Developer: Implement Fixes
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Developer. Fix the identified issues:

1. Read fixes-needed.md
2. Make targeted fixes (not full refactor)
3. Test fixes locally
4. Commit fixes to feature branch
5. Push updates
6. Document changes made

Deliverables:
- Fixed code committed to branch
- Brief summary of fixes made

steps.name: QA: Retest After Fixes
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade QA. Retest the fixed code:

1. Run same build verification
2. Run same test suite
3. Run same regression tests
4. Run same device testing
5. Check if identified issues are resolved
6. Report new findings

Deliverables:
- Updated test results
- Status of each previously-failed gate

steps.name: Reviewer: Rereview After Fixes
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Reviewer. Review the fixes:

1. Review only the changed code
2. Verify fixes address review comments
3. Check for new issues introduced
4. Approve fixes OR request further changes

Deliverables:
- Review of fixes
- Approval or further issues

steps.name: Lead: Check if Fixed
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Lead. Assess if fixes resolved the issues:

1. Review updated test results
2. Review updated code review
3. Check acceptance gates again
4. If ALL gates now PASS → Exit loop to final acceptance
5. If gates still fail → Continue loop (or stop if unfixable)

Deliverables:
- Status of all gates after fixes
- Continue or stop decision

steps.breakCondition: All acceptance gates PASS or unfixable blocker identified

steps.name: Final: Create Acceptance Report
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Lead. Create the final acceptance report:

1. Verify ALL acceptance gates PASS:
   - Gate 1: Feature Completeness ✅
   - Gate 2: Regression Testing ✅
   - Gate 3: Tests ✅
   - Gate 4: Linting & Build ✅
   - Gate 5: Android Build ✅
   - Gate 6: Device Testing ✅
   - Gate 7: Defect Review ✅
   - Gate 8: Privacy Compliance ✅
   - Gate 9: Documentation ✅
   - Gate 10: Git Status ✅

2. Compile final acceptance report:
   - Feature name and scope
   - All 10 gates with status
   - What was implemented
   - Known issues (if any)
   - Build artifacts info
   - Git commit info
   - Sign-offs from all agents

3. Create changed files list
4. Create test results summary
5. Generate build artifact info

Deliverables:
- acceptance-report.md
- changed-files.md
- test-results-summary.md
- build-artifact-info.md
- known-issues.md (if any)

Reference: 06-acceptance-gates.md for gate definitions

steps.name: Create GitHub Pull Request
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Developer. Create the GitHub pull request:

1. Feature branch: feature/[feature-name]
2. Target: develop branch (NOT main)
3. Title: [Feature Name] - [Brief Description] (max 70 chars)
4. Description:
   - Summary of changes
   - Acceptance criteria met
   - Testing performed
   - Known issues (if any)
   - Link to acceptance report
   - Sign-off: Passed all 10 acceptance gates

5. Use gh CLI: gh pr create --title "..." --body "..."

Deliverables:
- GitHub PR URL
- PR number
- PR created successfully

steps.name: Overnight Delivery: COMPLETE
steps.prompt:
You are the Arcade Lead. Summarize the completed delivery:

1. All tasks completed:
   - ✅ Task intake & scope
   - ✅ Implementation plan
   - ✅ Feature developed
   - ✅ QA testing (regression, device)
   - ✅ Code review (independent)
   - ✅ Acceptance gates verified (all 10 PASS)
   - ✅ Pull request created

2. Create final summary:
   - Feature: [name]
   - Status: READY FOR MERGE
   - Build: [APK info]
   - PR: [URL]
   - All 15 games: Working
   - Device tested: Yes
   - No blockers: Yes
   - Ready for production: Yes

3. Next steps:
   - PR review on GitHub
   - Merge to develop when approved
   - Optionally: Build and deploy to staging/production

Deliverables:
- Final delivery summary

artifacts.implementation-plan.md: Detailed step-by-step plan created by Planner
artifacts.acceptance-report.md: Final report with all 10 gates status
